options.name: attempt_interval
options.description: The interval between retry attempts. Possible range is 0-1h.

options.name: description
options.description: Description of the media type.

options.name: event_menu
options.description: Can be used when I(type=webhook). Includes entry in Event menu with link to created external ticket.

options.name: event_menu_name
options.description: Requred when I(event_menu=true). Event menu entry name.

options.name: event_menu_url
options.description: Requred when I(event_menu=true). Event menu entry underlying URL.

options.name: gsm_modem
options.description: Serial device name of the gsm modem. Required when I(type=sms).

options.name: http_login_password
options.description: Basic Auth password

options.name: http_login_user
options.description: Basic Auth login

options.name: max_attempts
options.description: The maximum number of attempts to send an alert. Possible range is 0-10.

options.name: max_sessions
options.description: The maximum number of alerts that can be processed in parallel. Possible value is 1 when I(type=sms) and 0-100 otherwise.

options.name: message_format
options.description: Can be used when I(type=email).

options.name: message_templates
options.description: Default notification messages for the event types.

options.name: message_text_limit
options.description: The message text limit. Required when I(type=ez_texting). 160 characters for USA and 136 characters for Canada.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the media type.

options.name: password
options.description: Authentication password. Required when I(type=jabber) or I(type=ez_texting). Required when I(type=email) and I(smtp_authentication=true).

options.name: process_tags
options.description: Can be used when I(type=webhook). Process returned JSON property values as tags. These tags are added to the already existing (if any) problem event tags in Zabbix.

options.name: script_name
options.description: The name of the executed script. Required when I(type=script).

options.name: script_params
options.description: List of script parameters. Required when I(type=script).

options.name: smtp_authentication
options.description: Whether SMTP authentication with username and password should be enabled or not. If set to C(true), C(username) and C(password) should be specified.

options.name: smtp_email
options.description: Email address from which notifications will be sent. Required when I(type=email).

options.name: smtp_helo
options.description: SMTP HELO. Required when I(type=email).

options.name: smtp_security
options.description: SMTP connection security level to use.

options.name: smtp_server
options.description: SMTP server host. Required when I(type=email).

options.name: smtp_server_port
options.description: SMTP server port. Required when I(type=email).

options.name: smtp_verify_host
options.description: SSL verify host for SMTP. Can be specified when I(smtp_security=STARTTLS) or I(smtp_security=SSL/TLS)

options.name: smtp_verify_peer
options.description: SSL verify peer for SMTP. Can be specified when I(smtp_security=STARTTLS) or I(smtp_security=SSL/TLS)

options.name: state
options.description: Desired state of the mediatype. On C(present), it will create a mediatype if it does not exist or update the mediatype if the associated data is different. On C(absent), it will remove the mediatype if it exists.

options.name: status
options.description: Whether the media type is enabled or no.

options.name: type
options.description: Type of the media type. Media types I(jabber) and I(ez_texting) works only with Zabbix versions 4.2 or older.

options.name: username
options.description: Username or Jabber identifier. Required when I(type=jabber) or I(type=ez_texting). Required when I(type=email) and I(smtp_authentication=true).

options.name: webhook_params
options.description: Can be used when I(type=webhook). Webhook variables that are passed to webhook script when executed.

options.name: webhook_script
options.description: Required when I(type=webhook). JavaScript code that will perform webhook operation. This code has access to all parameters in I(webhook_params). It may perform HTTP GET, POST, PUT and DELETE requests and has control over HTTP headers and request body. It may return OK status along with an optional list of tags and tag values or an error string.

options.name: webhook_timeout
options.description: Can be used when I(type=webhook). Execution timeout for JavaScript code in I(webhook_script). Possible values are 1-60s.
